description: This source file defines two internal sealed classes, VoidCodec and VoidCopier, which provide serialization and copying functionalities for unknown or null types within the Orleans.Serialization framework. VoidCodec handles writing and reading references with special handling for null values, while VoidCopier provides a deep copy method that expects null inputs.

classes.name: VoidCodec
classes.description: Serializer for unknown or null types, implementing the IFieldCodec interface.

classes.name: VoidCopier
classes.description: Provides deep copy functionality for unknown or null types, implementing IDeepCopier.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field value, handling null references appropriately.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value, ensuring wire type consistency and handling references.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input object; expects null input.
